notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.7
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Couriers,[/b] [/h2][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. In this update, we focused on fixing critical issues and adding the long-awaited handcart system. We’re eager to hear your thoughts on the changes![/p][p][b]⚠️ Important:[/b] We’ve made changes to the game’s core systems, which required resetting all save files. We’re sorry for the inconvenience. While the full version is still in development, we’ll keep polishing the demo to make it more stable and enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues with missing packages, stuck items, and incorrect cargo placement behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the issue where large-sized cargo was visible before being unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent reactions when picking up packages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where undelivered items remained in the system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed customer pickup triggers not activating properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the dispatch truck did not appear as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed repeated and incorrect sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with customers not appearing or spawning in the wrong locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Broken confirmation screens and negative balances have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]UI and data synchronization issues have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overlapping UI elements, frozen screens, and unresponsive buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue caused by saving the game while a package was on the scale.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a handcart (trolley) to make package transport easier.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/wvkQtee.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added numpad support to the cargo terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Enter" and "Space" key support for terminal confirmations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an info panel for held packages (bottom right corner).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506381/9c0fa7be982ec23201edb401bfefbd03423df51c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Cargo weight now affects player movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added widescreen support.[/p][/*][*][p]New languages added: German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian (translations are machine-generated).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new terminal on the cargo truck to remove lost dispatch packages from the panel.
[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/XQpV0Cw.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][/h2][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved cargo placement mechanics for better accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated layout and readability of the cargo dispatch panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Account numbers in money transfers are now six digits.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved throw physics based on cargo weight.[/p][/*][*][p]Warning messages added for invalid or unusable actions.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some sound effects are not affected by the SFX volume settings.
[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Barcode scanning and label printing.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Don’t forget to join our Discord channel to share your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Situation Update & Patch V0.0.5(6)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Couriers![/h2]

Thank you all for your interest in the game. As a two-person team, we have worked tirelessly to bring our first game to life. However, it seems that our internal testing was not sufficient, leading to many issues that you’ve encountered. We sincerely apologize for this.

Despite these issues, we are incredibly grateful for your positive feedback and for reporting bugs through various channels. Your support means the world to us. Our biggest motivation is to make the game an enjoyable experience for everyone.

With that in mind, and considering community feedback, we have decided to postpone the Early Access release to Q2 2025 to ensure a more stable and polished experience.

Thank you again for your support! We will keep you updated on our progress.


[h1]Patch Notes V0.0.5[/h1]

This update includes the implementation of some features from our to-do list and fixes for identified issues.


[h2]Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the cashier would not deliver the package the next day if a customer was present when the day ended.
[*] Fixed potential issues in the cargo production algorithm.
[*] Fixed an issue where throwing multiple cargos at the worker behind the cargo truck could cause a break.
[*] Fixed an issue where the evening cargo dispatch panel was visible while in the Cargo Terminal.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would not appear when returning to the report screen after using Alt+Tab.
[*] Fixed an issue where payments had an incorrect due date.
[*] Fixed an issue where purchased upgrades did not activate immediately.
[*] Fixed an issue where cargo would remain floating when placed on the fridge.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear when changing resolution settings.
[*] Restored resolution settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where cargo could be thrown behind walls.
[/list]


[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Interaction with the Cargo Terminal is now automatic.
[*] New dispatch system: The truck arriving in the evening will now request specific cargos.
[*] Updated keybinding states.
[*] Improved cargo physics and throwing mechanics.
[*] Improved customer arrival algorithm.
[*] Economy Balancing
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

Temporary workaround: Some issues may be resolved by returning to the main menu.
[list]
[*] Customers may sometimes not leave after delivering or receiving cargo.
[*] In rare cases, cargo trucks may arrive back-to-back.
[*] In rare cases, cargo on the scale may not appear on the scale panel.
[*] Some cargo features may become deactivated during day transitions.
[*] There is an issue where purchasing the Cold Chain feature prevents fridges from unlocking.
[*] Some audio effects are not affected by the SFX settings.
[*] When placing cargos on shelves, they may disappear or get stuck in hand.
[*] Tutorial objective updates are not functioning properly.
[/list]


[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adding a dolly (two-wheeler) for carrying multiple cargos.
[*] Improving and polishing existing mechanics.
[*] Adding numpad support.
[*] Expanding keybinding options.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Final Words[/h2]

The demo is a version we have prepared to test the core mechanics of the game. We will continue releasing updates until the mechanics in the demo are fully polished and bug free. If you are interested in the game, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist for more content in the full release.
We are planning to run a public playtest before the Early Access release. We will keep you updated as developments progress. Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BBFRh3FbDq]Discord[/url] channel to stay informed.

[h2]Hotfix v0.0.5(6)[/h2]

We updated the game a few hours ago, but we noticed that the evening cargo truck was arriving simultaneously with the morning cargo truck. This patch addresses that issue.

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you for playing the Cargo Delivery Simulator Demo! Your support helps us find and fix bugs faster. In this patch:[/h2]

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when the day ended while the customer's package was on the cargo terminal table.
[*] Fixed an issue where an auto-save occurred when returning to the main menu, but the wrong UI was displayed.
[*] Fixed the visual bug caused by throwing cargo again before the NPC's animation in the cargo truck finished.
[*] Fixed a registration system error that caused multiple bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed negative values for the cargo on the delivery truck.
[*] Fixed a model issue with small cold chain packages.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Packages are no longer visually separated into delivery and pick up categories. Package colors are now randomized. This potential clutter will make the shelf system more important and encourage organization.
[*] The cargo size algorithm now works more naturally.
[/list]

[b]Added to Known Issues:[/b] The required cargo count and UI position for the evening delivery truck may not sync properly.

[b]Current Demo Update Plan:[/b] No changes

[h2]Don't forget to add the full version of the game to your wishlist and share your feedback with us. 
Have fun![/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for playing Cargo Delivery Simulator Demo! Your support helps us improve the game. Feel free to join our Discord to share more thoughts and suggestions. We've addressed several bugs and improvements in this patch.[/b]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the UI overlay issue in the terminal when a package is placed on the table without entering a code.
[*] Fixed the issue where the cursor disappears when the tablet is opened and closed while on the cargo terminal.
[*] Fixed the incorrect calculations in the end-of-day report.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented sounds from updating in the settings.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the player from jumping.
[/list]

[h3][b]UX Adjustments & Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can throw your packages to a guy behind the truck, and he’ll catch them. (Best coworker in the world!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XpfHbNI.gif[/img]

[*] We added some SFX and made various UI improvements.
[*] We've changed the right-click condition on the desk. (No more stuck feeling!)
[*] The automatic exit from the panel after confirming for pickup type packages has been removed. 
[*] An info section has been added to the cargo terminal for incorrectly recorded packages and transfers
[*] The cargo truck arriving in the evening will now park in front of the office and leave when all the packages are delivered. 
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The bug that causes the Cargo Terminal to break when the day ends with a customer present after 18:00.
[*] Player movement is not affected by cargo weight.
[*] Right mouse click package drop placement cancelled for now
[*] We are aware of the unusual update sizes. We are working on it.
[/list]

[h3][b]Current Update Plan For The Demo[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes & improvements
[*] Refund type packages
[*] Cargo trolley to carry multiple parcels at once
[/list]

[h3]We’re working hard to bring updates and fixes for the demo. Thanks for your continued support and make sure you wishlist the full game![/h3]
